clips.claim: Bundeswehr zur stärksten konventionellen Armee in Europa machen
clips.title: FULL SPEECH: Germany Will Build Europe’s Strongest Army, Says Chancellor Friedrich Merz | AC14
clips.quote: We are transforming our army, the Bundeswehr, into the, quote, strongest conventional army in Europe. Our new military strategy puts political intent into a coherent military framework.
clips.speaker: Friedrich Merz
